## Description

A clear and concise description of the bug and what you expected to happen.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Go to ...
2. Click on ...
3. Scroll down to ...
4. Observe the error

## Expected behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual behavior

What actually happened. Include any error messages shown in the UI or the console.

## Screenshots

If applicable, attach screenshots or a screen recording that show the problem.

## Environment

- Device: e.g. Desktop, mobile phone
- Browser: e.g. Chrome 120, Safari 17, Firefox 121
- Version: e.g. v3.0
- Mode: Web app / Desktop app (Electron)
- Model in use (if relevant): e.g. deepseek, gpt-4o, etc.

## Additional context

Any other details about the setup (local features, stored data, etc.) that may be relevant.
